title: Rotate the two secrets the run exposed, and retire the master secret from the phone

intro.verdict_html: During the run two secrets were exposed once: the Google service-account key was printed into the session's own output, and the app's master secret was sent in one request to an old tunnel address that was offline. Neither is known to have reached anyone, but both should be replaced. Do this after the new iPhone Shortcuts work, because replacing the master secret stops the old Shortcuts.
prerequisites: The new iPhone Shortcuts built and working (their own checklist)
Google Cloud console access for the service account

steps.title: Make a new value
steps.body_html: Run the line below. It prints a new random value; copy it.

steps.title: Put it in Vercel
steps.body_html: Edit API_SECRET (Production): paste the new value, Save, then Redeploy the latest deployment.

steps.title: Put it in .env.local on the PC
steps.body_html: Open A:/Projects/Mycelium/.env.local and replace the value on the API_SECRET= line. While there: there are two CRON_SECRET= lines; delete the lower one (line 50 or thereabouts). The upper one is the one production uses.

notes.html: The tickets command line and the PC worker read this file. Nothing else needs changing: the new Shortcuts use their own token, not this secret.

steps.title: Check the old Shortcuts are dead and the new ones are not
steps.body_html: Run an old capture Shortcut if you still have one: it should fail. Run the new Capture: it should save. Delete the old Shortcuts.

steps.title: Create a new key and delete the old one

where.label: Google Cloud → IAM & Admin → Service Accounts

steps.body_html: Open the Mycelium service account → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON. A file downloads. Then delete the older key in the same list.

steps.title: Replace it in Vercel and in .env.local
steps.body_html: The key lives in the variable GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY. Replace its value with the private_key from the new file, keeping the same form the old value had (the whole key, including its BEGIN and END lines), in Vercel (Production, then Redeploy) and in .env.local. Delete the downloaded file afterwards.

steps.title: Check the finance sheet still loads
steps.body_html: Open the snapshot and press refresh. Figures should load as before.
